#d74035e30e.en:
Zuljin is the Warlord of the Amani forest Trolls. A powerful and fierce troll, Zul'jin has an immense hatred towards the High Elves of Quel'thalas, and this hatred led him into seeking unlikely allies in the form of outlandish invading Orcs.
|n|cffffcc00Attacks land and air units.|r

#23403d5bd6.en:
Dal'Rend Blackhand is the oldest son of Blackhand the Destroyer, former Warchief of the Orcish Horde. Following his father’s removal at the hands of Orgrim Doomhammer, Rend and his brother Maim have led the Blacktooth Grin Clan and its elite frontline warriors. 
|n|cffffcc00Attacks land units.|r
